How it works

1 · Each preliminary radiology report is paired with the attending's attested version.

2 · The dataset is sent to the LLM of your choice for analysis using a preconfigured prompt.

3 · Output is a downloadable Excel workbook containing your individualized feedback. This can also be viewed here.

Analysis settings
Demo mode is for local use only. Live mode uses two OpenAI models: the Stage 1 classifier (default gpt-6-luna) judges each edit, and the Stage 3 narrative model (default gpt-6.1-sol) writes the rotation summary.
Held in browser memory for this session only: never stored, never sent anywhere. Use a dedicated key with a spend cap.
Stage 1 classifier Stage 3 narrative
Use API model IDs (gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-4o, …): typed names like "GPT-6.1 Sol" are normalized automatically. Right column = your account's tokens/min for that model (platform.openai.com → Settings → Limits); defaults match a Tier-1 account. The app paces itself under these limits, strips request options a model doesn't accept, and auto-adjusts if the API reports different limits: a 429 pauses and resumes, it never kills the run.
A results JSON downloaded from Assess Feedback opens as a LOADED RUN: no network, no model call. Its overrides are applied; regenerating its summaries needs Live mode and a key.
Share these results
A share file is this page with the results inside: it opens straight on the results, with no upload, no key and no network. Your API key is never written into it.
